message.content: {"note_claim": "FC Schalke 04 ultras marched through Dublin on Oct 11, 2025 ahead of a friendly vs Bohemians, with roughly 2,000 Schalke supporters travelling/taking part.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "It said about 2,000 of its fans had travelled to Dublin to support the team and what happened did not reflect the character of the club or its supporters.", "reason": "The Irish Times article (Oct 13, 2025) confirms Schalke ultras marched through Dublin city centre on Saturday ahead of the Bohemians friendly and that about 2,000 Schalke fans travelled, matching the note's claims."}

parsed.note_claim: FC Schalke 04 ultras marched through Dublin on Oct 11, 2025 ahead of a friendly vs Bohemians, with roughly 2,000 Schalke supporters travelling/taking part.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: It said about 2,000 of its fans had travelled to Dublin to support the team and what happened did not reflect the character of the club or its supporters.
parsed.reason: The Irish Times article (Oct 13, 2025) confirms Schalke ultras marched through Dublin city centre on Saturday ahead of the Bohemians friendly and that about 2,000 Schalke fans travelled, matching the note's claims.
